add.k: The judge presiding over Hector Ayala's murder trial
add.tm: Supreme Court State of New York
st: Cooper denies Hector Ayala bail, bars any talk of White Tiger at trial, then berates Matt for revealing it and frees Ayala.

files.notes: Only 'Jerry' is said in his first appearance (Hochberg: 'This is some bullshit, Jerry.'); 'Judge Cooper' and 'The Honorable Fitzgerald Cooper' are said in The Hollow of His Hand, so the name is staged. Group is the court as the bailiff announces it ('Supreme Court State of New York, part 20'); the app had no name for it.

k: A New Yorker held hostage at New York Mutual Bank
A city sanitation worker of 35 years
st: Held hostage in the bank, Johnny vouches for Matt to police, then tells Mayor Fisk that Muse's murals are made of human blood.

files.notes: Not named in With Interest; Sheila introduces him as 'John Santini from Sanitation' and he says 'call me Johnny' in Excessive Force. Group named on screen only as 'Sanitation' ('I work at the Sanitation'); staged to his episode 6 reveal.

st: Gomez confronts Fisk over his Safer Streets powers, backs the Governor on Red Hook, and hears Buck hint he could replace her.

files.notes: On screen in The Northern Star (1), The Scales & the Sword (3) and Requiem (6). Whether he acts on Cashman's suggestion is not shown by the end of S2.

add.k: A corrupt cop and Connor Powell's partner
st: On New Year's Eve, Shanahan and Powell rough up Nicky Torres until Hector Ayala intervenes, and Shanahan falls in front of a train.

files.notes: On screen only in Optics; 'Officer Shanahan' is said there, 'Kel' first in The Hollow of His Hand. op is Hector Ayala (White Tiger), the hero he fights.

add.k: A hungry petty thief and one of Matt's clients
st: Leroy is jailed for stealing caramel corn, rails at Matt over a ten day deal, serves his time, and is later seen out on the street.

files.notes: Speaking role in Sic Semper Systema (4); mentioned by name in Isle of Joy (8); seen free on a street, without lines, in Straight to Hell (9) per the MCU wiki gallery ('Free Leroy Bradford'). No group: Independent.

add.k: Foggy's childhood bully, now a drug dealer
st: In the past, Lionel refuses a deadly plea deal, walks free on a bad warrant, and flees with Foggy's savings before Buck arrives.

files.notes: All on screen in The Grand Design (2014 scenes). He says 'the guys I work with want me dead' and Wesley tells Fisk 'We may have an issue with the Lion', so he is placed in the app's Fisk's Empire, then Independent once he runs. Ray is his neighborhood name; the Lion is Wesley's name for him.

add.k: A Five Families boss feuding with Viktor
st: Luca feuds with Viktor over tolls, defies Fisk over a $1.8 million debt, plots with Vanessa to kill him, and is shot by Buck.

files.notes: On screen in episodes 1, 3, 6, 7. 'Five Families' is said in Heaven's Half Hour. Daredevil foils the bank robbery Luca's crew stages to raise the money (With Interest), but they never meet; his main foe on screen is Fisk.

add.k: A police informant and the key witness for Hector Ayala
st: Nicky flees a beating by Powell and Shanahan, escapes his apartment with Matt's help, then lies on the stand at Ayala's trial.

files.notes: An informant for Powell and Shanahan, not a member of any group: Independent.

add.k: A Five Families boss in a toll feud with Luca
st: Viktor mocks Luca's Red Hook toll at Vanessa's table, then accepts Buck Cashman's ruling that Luca owes him $1.8 million.

files.notes: On screen in Heaven's Half Hour (1) and The Hollow of His Hand (3); only mentioned later. No hero confronts him on screen; op set to the show's lead, opp left empty.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cooper denies Matt's bail request for Hector Ayala but sides with him in chambers, keeping White Tiger out of the trial. When Matt reveals Ayala is White Tiger anyway, Cooper calls him slippery for misleading the court but lets the trial go on.
stages.whoA: Defense lawyer in the Ayala trial

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cooper remands Hector without bail on the charge of killing a police officer. After the jury finds him not guilty on every count, Cooper tells him he is free to go.
stages.whoB: Judge who denies bail, then frees him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Held hostage together at New York Mutual Bank, Johnny tells Matt the vault holds only safety deposit boxes. When the police clear the bank, Johnny vouches that Matt was a hostage.
stages.whoB: Fellow hostage who vouches for him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Johnny tells Mayor Fisk he voted for him and has worked in Sanitation for 35 years. He then reveals that Muse's mural is made of human blood, and Fisk sends for Gallo.
stages.whoB: Sanitation worker who finds the blood

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Sheila brings Johnny to Fisk's office with urgent news about the mural. When he rambles, she pushes him to tell the Mayor what he told her.
stages.whoA: Aide who brings him to the Mayor

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Gomez and the Attorney General confront Fisk over his emergency powers and the Safer Streets Initiative. He later stands beside Governor McCaffrey as she warns Fisk she can revoke Red Hook's free port status.
stages.whoA: Mayor he challenges for the state

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Gomez tells Governor McCaffrey the Red Hook charter came from an anonymous source, and she tells him nothing is anonymous. Later he tells Buck Cashman she promised to back his run for her office.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Gomez demands to know what the CIA is doing in Fisk's office. Mr. Charles mocks his job title and calls him Juan.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: At the Gracie Mansion dinner, Daniel pumps a drunk Gomez for talk about the Governor. Gomez insists she is squeaky clean, but Daniel says everybody has something.
stages.whoB: Lieutenant Governor he pumps for dirt

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: At Vanessa's wake, Gomez tells Buck that McCaffrey promised to support his candidacy. Buck asks why he should wait and hints he may not need to campaign at all.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Shanahan and Powell rough up their informant Nicky Torres in a subway station, and Shanahan dies in the fight with Hector Ayala. On the stand, Powell calls Kel his partner of eight years and his best friend.
stages.whoB: His late partner and best friend

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hector steps in as Shanahan and Powell beat Nicky Torres. Shanahan charges him, misses, trips and falls in front of a train, and Hector is charged with his murder.
stages.whoA: The man he charges on the platform
stages.whoB: Cop whose death he is tried for

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Shanahan and Powell accuse their informant Nicky of dodging them and start beating him on a subway platform. Shanahan grabs him, then lets go to help Powell, and Nicky runs.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Matt takes Leroy's caramel corn theft case, and Leroy insists on probation while mocking his blindness. Matt wins him ten days and loses his temper, then listens as Leroy explains how the system keeps grinding him down.
stages.whoB: Client in a caramel corn theft

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Lionel, who bullied Foggy as a boy, turns up as his client and refuses a plea deal. Foggy finds the flaw in the warrant that frees him, then gives him the firm's savings to start over, and Lionel says he never had a friend like that.
stages.whoA: Childhood neighbor who gives him a fresh start

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Matt and Foggy are assigned to get Lionel to plead out, but he mocks Matt's blindness and refuses. Matt doubts he deserves to walk, yet helps get the charges thrown out over the bad warrant.
stages.whoB: Client freed on a bad warrant

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Vanessa runs the Five Families table and rules that Red Hook is exempt from Luca's toll. Luca later urges her to take back control and get rid of Wilson, and her text sends him into Buck Cashman's ambush.
stages.whoA: She runs the Five Families table
stages.whoB: Five Families boss she sets up

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Luca barges into the Mayor's office and refuses to pay Viktor, so Fisk raises his debt to $2.8 million. Luca later sneaks up on Fisk at a restaurant with a gun, and Buck shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The Mayor he tries to kill

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Luca demands a toll from Viktor's trucks, and Viktor reminds him Red Hook is exempt. After a deadly hijacking, Luca is ordered to pay Viktor $1.8 million and refuses.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck tells Luca he owes Viktor $1.8 million, and Luca calls him the mayor's errand boy. When Luca moves on Fisk at a restaurant, Buck is waiting and kills him.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Vanessa scolds Viktor for being rude at the Five Families table but backs him on the Red Hook toll. The meeting ends when Wilson Fisk walks in.
stages.whoA: She runs the Five Families table

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck settles the hijacking feud for the Fisks and rules that Luca owes Viktor $1.8 million. Viktor is satisfied with the terms.
stages.whoA: Fisk's fixer who rules in his favor

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Matt finds Nicky first and sends him out the fire escape before the cops arrive to silence him. On the stand, Nicky lies that he was home all night, and Matt withdraws him as a witness.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Powell and Shanahan accuse Nicky of dodging them and beat him in a subway station. Powell later tracks him to his apartment to stop him from testifying.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hector breaks up the beating Nicky is taking from two cops, and Nicky runs. Called to back Hector's story at trial, Nicky lies and says he was never there.
stages.whoB: Man he saved, who lies in court

dropped.why: Never named on screen: the transcripts of The Scales & the Sword, The Hateful Darkness and The Southern Cross never say 'Luna' (only 'Chief Justice Waters' and 'Your Honors'), and the bench shots show no nameplate. Name comes from the credits only.

Never named on screen: the Optics transcript never says 'Williams' (Powell calls him nothing; subtitles label him OFFICER), and he wears plain clothes with no name tag. Name comes from the credits only.

changes.where: tie Judge Cooper|Matt Murdock, Daredevil: Born Again S1, text
changes.was: Cooper denies Matt's bail request for Hector Ayala but sides with him in chambers, keeping White Tiger out of the trial. When Matt reveals Ayala is White Tiger anyway, Cooper calls him a slippery hypocrite but lets the trial go on.
changes.now: Cooper denies Matt's bail request for Hector Ayala but sides with him in chambers, keeping White Tiger out of the trial. When Matt reveals Ayala is White Tiger anyway, Cooper calls him slippery for misleading the court but lets the trial go on.
changes.why: Cooper calls Matt 'a real slippery piece of shit' who misled him; the hypocrisy jab ('Division of Hypocrisy') is Hochberg's line, not Cooper's.

changes.where: tie Juan Gomez|Daniel Blake, Daredevil: Born Again S2, text
changes.was: At the Gracie Mansion dinner, Daniel tries to get Gomez drunk and talking about the Governor. Gomez insists she is squeaky clean, but Daniel says everybody has something.
changes.now: At the Gracie Mansion dinner, Daniel pumps a drunk Gomez for talk about the Governor. Gomez insists she is squeaky clean, but Daniel says everybody has something.
changes.why: Nothing shows Daniel getting Gomez drunk; the wiki has Daniel trying to get information out of an already drunk Gomez, and the dialogue is Gomez calling her squeaky clean and 'Everybody's got something.'
